report.summary: All four failures come from two seeded product bugs in app/main.py, not from flakiness or test mistakes. The app is serving the `leak_books` behaviour (GET /api/books and the books page list every user's books) and the `year_off_by_one` behaviour (next year is accepted as a year). Fix the app first: restrict the book listing to the owner, and cap the year at the current year. The repo does not set BUGS anywhere, so check the CI/app environment for a stray BUGS=... value.

causes.title: Book listing returns every user's books
causes.explanation: With the leak_books flag active, list_books() drops the owner_id filter and returns all rows. That breaks the API isolation test, and it also breaks the UI new-user test: a brand-new user sees other users' books on /books, so the table is non-empty and the empty-state element never renders. The test assertions are correct; the app is wrong every time the flag is on.
evidence: tests/api/test_books_api.py:42: assert book["id"] not in other_ids  ->  "assert 2 not in [1, 2]"
app/main.py:163-164: if "leak_books" in BUGS: rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM books ORDER BY id").fetchall()
app/main.py:166 (correct path): WHERE owner_id = ? is only used when leak_books is off
UI aria snapshot for the brand-new user lists rows "Final title Someone 2001", "From API-ba273c99 Robot" and other users' books, which the new user never created
causes.suggested_fix: Restore the owner filter in list_books(): always run SELECT * FROM books WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY id. Remove the leak_books branch. Make sure the CI/app environment does not set BUGS=leak_books.

causes.title: Publication year accepts next year
causes.explanation: With the year_off_by_one flag active, validate_book() sets max_year to this_year + 1, so a year of today+1 is accepted with 201 instead of rejected with 422. The API test expects a 422 and the UI test expects an error message; neither gets one, and the book is saved and listed with year 2027. The repo's default code (max_year = this_year) would reject it, so the tests are correct.
evidence: app/main.py:94: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:44: expect(books.error).to_contain_text("Year must be between")  ->  "element(s) not found"
UI aria snapshot shows the saved row "Future-75ccdf87 Someone 2027 Delete" (the rejected book was saved)
causes.suggested_fix: Set max_year = this_year in validate_book() by removing the year_off_by_one branch. Make sure the CI/app environment does not set BUGS=year_off_by_one. Re-run both tests to confirm.
